_comment: Not a ruleset: the repository labels the shared workflows are triggered by, applied with
the labels API. It lives beside the rulesets because apply.sh checks and writes it the
same way, and the same question -- does this repo match the standard -- covers it.
claude-review is the ONE label that requests a Claude review, and the review uses Opus
(the `model` default in claude-review.yml). Its colour is orange, F97316, which used to
mark the per-model labels. It replaces both the old yellow `claude-review` and
`claude-review:opus`, so every inline finding on a PR came from the same model and an
`renamed_from` maps a retired name to the label that replaces it. Where both exist the
OLD target is deleted first and the retired label is renamed over it, so a PR that
carries the retired label keeps a label (the workflow consumes it either way). A repo
with neither gets the label created. Only the names listed here are touched.

claude-review.description: Cold-context Claude review using Opus (consumed by the workflow; re-add for another pass)
